AWS::CodeDeployBlueGreen.description: Generates the resources of an ECS blue/green deployment through CodeDeploy from the template's `Hooks` section.

AWS::Include.description: Inserts the template snippet stored in Amazon S3 in its place, merged with the map holding the call.

arguments.name: Location
arguments.description: The snippet's Amazon S3 location, `s3://<bucket>/<key>`.

AWS::LanguageExtensions.description: Resolves `Fn::ForEach`, `Fn::Length`, `Fn::ToJsonString` and intrinsic functions written where they are otherwise not allowed.

AWS::SecretsManager-2020-07-23.description: Generates a rotation Lambda function, in a nested stack, for each `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule` with `HostedRotationLambda`.

AWS::SecretsManager-2024-09-16.description: Generates a rotation Lambda function, in a nested stack, for each `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule` with `HostedRotationLambda`, upgrading the function on each stack update.

AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31.description: Expands the AWS SAM resource types, such as `AWS::Serverless::Function`, into CloudFormation resources.

AWS::ServiceCatalog.description: Replaces each `[[servicecatalog:provisionedproduct:<product>:<output_key>]]` string with that provisioned product's output.

And.description: Is true when every one of its 2 to 10 conditions is true.

arguments.name: first
arguments.description: A condition function, or `Condition: <name>`.

arguments.name: second
arguments.description: A condition function, or `Condition: <name>`.

arguments.name: more
arguments.description: Further conditions, up to 10 in all.

Base64.description: Returns the Base64 representation of the input string.

arguments.name: text
arguments.description: The text to encode.

Cidr.description: Divides an IP block into CIDR address blocks.

arguments.name: ip_block
arguments.description: The CIDR block to divide, such as `10.0.0.0/16`.

arguments.name: count
arguments.description: How many CIDR blocks to make, `1` to `256`.

arguments.name: cidr_bits
arguments.description: The host bits of each block: `32` minus its prefix length for IPv4, `128` for IPv6.

Contains.description: Is true when a string matches at least one value of a list of strings. Works only in the `Rules` section.

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: The list of strings.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The string compared with the list.

return.description: `true` when the string matches a value of the list.

EachMemberEquals.description: Is true when a string matches every value of a list. Works only in the `Rules` section.

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: The list of strings.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The string compared with each value.

return.description: `true` when every value equals the string.

EachMemberIn.description: Is true when each string of a list matches at least one value of a second list. Works only in the `Rules` section.

arguments.name: strings_to_check
arguments.description: The strings checked.

arguments.name: strings_to_match
arguments.description: The strings each checked string must match one of.

return.description: `true` when every checked string is in the second list.

Equals.description: Is true when its two values are equal.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The first value.

arguments.name: other_value
arguments.description: The value compared with it.

FindInMap.description: Returns the value at two keys of a map declared in the `Mappings` section.

arguments.name: map_name
arguments.description: The map's name in `Mappings`.

arguments.name: top_level_key
arguments.description: The key in the map.

arguments.name: second_level_key
arguments.description: The key under the top-level key.

arguments.name: default
arguments.description: `{ DefaultValue: <value> }`, returned where the keys find nothing. Needs the `AWS::LanguageExtensions` transform.

return.description: The value at the two keys.

ForEach.description: Repeats a fragment for each item of a collection. Needs the `AWS::LanguageExtensions` transform.

arguments.name: identifier
arguments.description: The identifier replaced by each item in the output key and value.

arguments.name: collection
arguments.description: The collection to iterate over.

arguments.name: fragment
arguments.description: The output key and value repeated for each item.

GetAZs.description: Returns the Availability Zones of a Region in alphabetical order.

arguments.name: region
arguments.description: The Region; `""` reads the stack's own.

GetAtt.description: Returns the value of an attribute of a resource in the template.

arguments.name: logical_id
arguments.description: The resource's logical ID, or `<logicalId>.<attribute>` written as one value.

arguments.name: attribute
arguments.description: The attribute's name.

GetStackOutput.description: Returns the value of an output of another stack, in this or another account or Region.

arguments.name: output
arguments.description: `StackName` and `OutputName`, with `Region` and `RoleArn` where the stack is elsewhere.

If.description: Returns one of two values by a condition.

arguments.name: condition
arguments.description: The condition's name in the `Conditions` section.

arguments.name: value_if_true
arguments.description: The value where the condition is true.

arguments.name: value_if_false
arguments.description: The value where the condition is false; `!Ref AWS::NoValue` leaves the property out.

ImportValue.description: Returns the value of an output another stack exports.

arguments.name: export_name
arguments.description: The name the value is exported under.

Join.description: Joins a list of values into one value, separated by the delimiter.

arguments.name: delimiter
arguments.description: The text between the values; `""` joins them with nothing.

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: The values to join.

Length.description: Returns the number of elements of a list. Needs the `AWS::LanguageExtensions` transform.

arguments.name: items
arguments.description: The list to count.

Not.description: Is true when its one condition is false.

arguments.name: condition
arguments.description: A list holding the one condition to negate.

Or.description: Is true when any one of its 2 to 10 conditions is true.

arguments.name: first
arguments.description: A condition function, or `Condition: <name>`.

arguments.name: second
arguments.description: A condition function, or `Condition: <name>`.

arguments.name: more
arguments.description: Further conditions, up to 10 in all.

RefAll.description: Returns every value of an AWS-specific parameter type in the stack's account and Region. Works only in the `Rules` section.

arguments.name: parameter_type
arguments.description: The AWS-specific parameter type, such as `AWS::EC2::VPC::Id`.

return.description: The values of the parameter type.

Select.description: Returns the item of a list at an index.

arguments.name: index
arguments.description: The item's position, from `0`.

arguments.name: values
arguments.description: The list to select from.

Split.description: Splits a string into a list of strings at the delimiter.

arguments.name: delimiter
arguments.description: The text to split at.

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: The text to split.

Sub.description: Substitutes the `${...}` variables in a string.

arguments.name: template
arguments.description: The text whose variables are substituted; `${!...}` stays literal.

arguments.name: variables
arguments.description: Variable name to value, for the names the template uses beyond parameters, resources and pseudo parameters.

return.description: The text with its variables substituted.

ToJsonString.description: Converts an object or a list to its JSON string. Needs the `AWS::LanguageExtensions` transform.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The object or list to convert.

Transform.description: Calls a macro to process part of the template, or, as the template's `Transform` section, the whole template.

arguments.name: Name
arguments.description: The macro's name: `AWS::Include`, another transform, or a macro the account registers.

arguments.name: Parameters
arguments.description: The macro's arguments, by name.

ValueOf.description: Returns the value or values of an attribute of a parameter's value. Works only in the `Rules` section.

arguments.name: parameter_logical_id
arguments.description: The parameter's name in the `Parameters` section.

arguments.name: attribute
arguments.description: The attribute, such as `VpcId` or `Tags.<tag_key>`.

return.description: The attribute's value, or a list of values for a parameter holding several.

ValueOfAll.description: Returns the values of an attribute for every value of an AWS-specific parameter type. Works only in the `Rules` section.

arguments.name: parameter_type
arguments.description: The AWS-specific parameter type, such as `AWS::EC2::VPC::Id`.

arguments.name: attribute
arguments.description: The attribute, such as `VpcId` or `Tags.<tag_key>`.
